test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined words in the given sentence.

Ranjith failed in all his exams__ as he had been addicted of __social media.

options.text: as he had been addicted at
as he had been addicted on
as he had been addicted in
as he had been addicted to

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct preposition to use with "addicted" is "to." The phrase should be "addicted to social media."

Therefore, the corrected sentence should be "Ranjith failed in all his exams as he had been addicted to social media."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "as he had been addicted at"** – Incorrect use of preposition; "addicted at" is wrong.
 
• **Option 2: "as he had been addicted on"** – Incorrect use of preposition; "addicted on" is wrong.
 
• **Option 3: "as he had been addicted in"** – Incorrect use of preposition; "addicted in" is wrong.
